transcription breaks one sentence across a plain blank line, the line that ends no sentence (`tail`) and the line
that continues it (`head`), found by kb/Work PB479's design-review probe (a line ending no sentence, blank lines
only, then a lowercase opening that is no lettered item). `text_units.py --self-test` holds each pair in ONE unit.
`line` is the tail's line in specs/ISO_COBOL_2023.md when recorded (informative: the pair is the test).
